DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Adenocarcinoma

The biopsy confirms a well-differentiated adenocarcinoma of the endometrium, which explains your postmenopausal bleeding and the associated thickened endometrial stripe seen on ultrasound. The presence of an adnexal mass may represent a co-existing ovarian pathology or metastatic disease, which we will investigate further, but the primary malignancy is confirmed.
